listing.name: Unbalance Patch 2
listing.summary: Overhauls the game's balance by severely nerfing the economy, making ships more expensive and combat more punishing.

description:
Rewritten as of 25.05.2026

Unbalance Patch 2 is a terrifying reinterpretation of Starsector, where the player is broke. Pirates and Pathers are threatening. And the Core Worlds are oppressive. The economy has been severely nerfed. There are no longer easy pathways to success. Instead the player has to constantly struggle against being able to pay their crew wages, and being able to rebuild. Their constantly mowed down fleet

The Starsector balance has been drastically tweaked. Energy weapons are weaker. Ammo mechanics are back for ballistics. Cruisers and capitals feel slow, but more importantly, too expensive to be affordable to anyone. Game focuses a lot on fights between little and poor idiots. Throwing garbage cans and sinks at each other. Get yourself invested within the gameplay of having two Apogees and a Fury. Along a bunch of frigates and destroyers. Delivering packages to be able to pay the debt you have put yourself in, from trying to set up a colony.

The Core Worlds' massive fleets are at constant odds with the swarms of pirates that lurk beyond the horizon. Make yourself comfortable by playing towards both sides. Or slaughter in the name of one. Trade. Smuggle. Sneak. And die alone and miserable. With no one to help you. In the Persean Sector. A world within which many have seemingly lost hope. Instead pledging themselves to the ideals of strength and greed.

Most Recent Patch Notes:

1.4.2.2

SpoilerHighfix (redownload to acquire):

- Reverted the change that all beams deal 100% damage hit strength of DPS

- Reverted all the harsh nerfs to beam weapons that were intended to go with this change

- Reverted harsh nerfs to strong antiarmour weapons

- Please note the fact that minimum residual armour is 15% instead fo 5% in this mod

- Reverted some very harsh changes to Omega missile weapons

- Made a different approach rework to the Voidblaster. Now costs 300 flux to fire instead of having halved damage

Latefix (redownload to acquire)

- Gorgon/Hydra DEM back to vanilla status except with longer targeting timer for both and faster fire rate for Gorgon

- Expanded Mags gives 50% higher ammo capacity and 25% higher ammo regeneration

- Shield Shunt back to vanilla status

- Overhauled Eagle, Falcon, Brawler variants

- LG Brawler and LG Centurion now have High Energy Focus instead of their respective defensive systems

- Returned the amount of hostile activity fleets back to vanilla values

- Gave Hegemony and Sindrian Diktat some more weapons so that their Falcon and Eagle variants can function properly

Coldfix (redownload to acquire)

- Restored phase coil stress mechanics

- Phase coil stress occurs as if Adaptive Phase Cloak is installed as a hullmod at all times, topping at 75%. As this hullmod is not present in the game with this mod

- Increased Harbinger's mobility to vanilla status

Silverfix (redownload to acquire)

- Reduced Threat weapon OP costs to pre-nerf values to compensate for them being nerfed

- Changed the Voidblaster to deal lower damage but cost 200 flux. Damage is now 50% of what it is in vanilla

- Increased the growth penalty at colonies from 50% to 100% more growth required per level

Bronzefix (redownload to acquire)

- Made some final changes to boss weapon nerfs

- Most nerfs are now extremely tame and they more often than not just apply moderate changes to weapons nature than for example halve their damage

- Onslaught MK1 is now the exact same way when it was released, meaning it's extremely overpowered (except it costs twice as much and doesn't have Rugged construction)

- Set max colony size to 7

- Please note the player growth penalty per level increase has been doubled. Bringing a colony to level 7 on a planet with moderate hazard rating is nigh impossible

- Additionally please note that this has been balanced for Procgen Overhaul where Habitable and Mild Climate do not reduce hazard rating and only provide growth bonuses

- Nerfed Radiant by making it 40 DP

- Now uses Phase Skimmer again, which has been nerfed to not utilise charge mechanics and have a static 10 second cooldown

- Note Radiant's flux dissipation has been reduced to 1250 and a variety of large energies have been nerfed to make this idea more feasible

Goldfix (redownload to update)

- Reverted Invictus to pretty much vanilla Invictus in terms of stats. With the exception of having 40k flux capacity and 600 flux venting. So pre-nerf Invictus

- Nerfed Warthog to have 15 second respawn cooldown

- Nerfed Targeting Supercomputer (space station range modifier) to give only 150% bonus range rather than 250%, cause sieges are too hard against smaller ships

- Buffed Grendel. No longer has Distributed Fire Control. Now variants equip DTU. Safety Overrides Grendel is back in the game. And Luddic Path is using it

- Doubled mines hull from 500 to 1000 for Doom specifically, but also affects space stations

- Unnerfed Ziggurat motes to have vanilla health rather than 50% less health than in vanilla

- Reworked Fulgent for the nth time by making it 10 DP and NOT have Bolt Coherer

- Unnerfed Flash ammo count from 4 to 6 (same as in vanilla)

- Added some autofit changes that make it less probable for Salamander and Pilum to replace actual STRIKE weapons such as Typhoon

- Fixed some economies deciving without player intervention by giving them patrol HQ's or turning off Free Port

- Skathi, no longer has Free Port, because it was too bullied by Hegemony in conjunction with other factors. Least probable to decivilize, but still did it

- Agreus, gave Patrol HQ to counteract Luddic Path sabotages and make it more likely for it to recover the Relay for itself

- Orthrus, gave Patrol HQ, mostly so it's more likely to recover the relay for itself. Rather than let Hegemony claim two high quality relays

- Mairaath, gave Patrol HQ to raise stability and increase defences against lost trade fleets. And claim objectives in the system. Will check the player for Transponder in the system

Depleted Uranium fix (redownload to acquire)

- Buffed Advanced Optics

- Turn rate penalty is now 30% instead of 50%

- Damage penalty is now 15% instead of 25%

- Reworked Medusa, Shrike, Aurora variants to have higher base flux capacitors instead of utility hullmods

Plutonium Fix (redownload to acquire)

- Reworked Paragon variants to have less utility hullmods but more OP

- Reworked some Legion and Legion XIV variants

Hopefix? (redownload to acquire)

- Update rolled back[close]

1.4.2.2.1

Spoiler- Nerfed green DEM by reducing its ammo capacity by round half what it is in vanilla

- This has been done because Persean League feels too impossible to deal with without a hard-counter PD-centric fleet

- Applied a different nerf to lightning PD weapons

- Instead of having their damage halved, lightning PD weapons have their range reduced by 200 units

- This does not include the Omega PD lightning cannon which is back to exactly how it is in vanilla

- Reality Disruptor now does 100 energy damage and 1500 EMP damage per lightning strike, but it has a limited amount of charges it can fire of 10 and 15 with Expanded Magazine

- Auxiliary Thrusters back to having an s-mod effect, now costs the same amount of OP as ECCM, instead of Blast Doors

- Nerfed/Reworked Phase Lance

- Restored it to having 50% less DPS but a 3 second refire delay instead of 4. As it was before a certain ancient buff

- This allows Phase Lance to be fired in more flux restricted moments, and allows it to deal more EMP damage

- Increased shield efficiency of all Battlecruisers with the exception of Nova by 0.2

- This has been done to allow Battlecruisers to still perform a frontline role to an extent rather than force them to entirely rely on punching down or kiting

- This does not make Battlecruisers significantly more durable than battleships. And Nova already had a good shield, and the universe did not explode. So it's fine

- Fixed some incorrect tooltip information

- EMP now does 25 damage instead of 50 per lightning strike to make Omens and Shades more plausible to be countered with a shieldless ship like a Cerberus

- Note EMP gen can be used whilst firing

- Nerfed Missile Specialisation to only provide 25% bonus durability, just like in vanilla

- Added a new skill called Ground Operations. It can be found in the industry tree instead of Industrial Planning. It increases the potency of marine raids by a significant margin

- Removed the change to patrol interval. Patrol interval is now the exact same in vanilla

- This has been done to improve colony gameplay, and to make Core Worlds less infested

- This will also increase the defences of pirate and Pather stations, as previously those would be more often than not found unattended

Laserfix (redownload to acquire)

- Nerfed Reality Disruptor to behave like it does in vanilla, no longer uses Heatseeker tracking

- Now fizzles on reaching weapon range

Silverfix (redownload to acquire)

- Reverted Radiant to how it is mostly in vanilla

- Has 1500 flux dissipation, costs 60 DP

- Reduced the cost of Nova to vanilla

- Restored original Glimmer and Lumen flux stats

- Reduced DP cost of

Apogee and

Anubis back to 20 DP (reverted to just Anubis)

Zincfix (redownload to acquire)

- Nerfed Threat Fabricator by removing Advanced Targeting Core

- Added Dedicated Targeting Core to default variant

- Done this so that the ship does not stand out in comparison to the Guardian who also lost Advanced Targeting Core

- Also done to underline the uniqueness of Paragon

Darkfix (redownload to acquire)

- Nerfed Fulgent to be 11 DP instead of 10 as in vanilla

- This has been done so that it does not eclipse Shrike too much

Ebonyfix (redownload to acquire)

- Nerfed Gigacannon to have a proper amount of ammunition as originally intended

- Gigacannon now has 10 ammo capacity instead of 20

Woodfix (redownload to acquire)

- Nerfed Adjudicators' range to 600 from 800

- Note Adjudicator has been given damage and recharge values of before it was heavily nerfed in a vanilla hotfix

Cordial Fix (redownload to acquire)

- Nerfed some leadership/technology skills

- Cybernetic Augmentations no longer give reduced ECM penalty

- Officer Training/Management no longer gives bonus command points

- Support Doctrine no longer gives accelerated command point

changelog.1.4.2.2.4.3.3.7:
- Hyperion has Starfarer durability, ordnance points and speed
- Has phase teleporter that has a 0 second cooldown

- Phase ship durability set to vanilla

- Missile speed adjusted to be much slower across the board
- Mirroring fighter balance changes

- This also applies to Threat, Shrouded Dweller and Omega weapons
- This also applies to Canister Flak system

- You now always receive a reputation penalty when trading on the black market, regardless of transponder being on or off, as well as penalties related to selling military equipment and goods to the market you sell to adversary
- Anywhere
- Additionally the market's vulnerability to trade is increased by a factor of 10. Meaning you need to sell or buy only 100k worth of goods to incur the maximum available penalty

- Gave Path Paladin PD as they didn't have it
- Fulgent once again has High Energy Focus, as it is no longer considered slow for a destroyer, kinda
- Increased the amount of bombs for Piranha from 5 to 7 (note they do 600 damage each, instead of vanilla's 400)

- Doubled the speed at which everything travels in the campaign (reverted)
- Reduced the amount of patrols to vanilla level

- Removed the Ancyra's military base as it was causing a bug where a person with no title would be generated

- Paladin PD quasi reworked to its Starfarer version

- Gave Broadsword and Lux Swarmer missiles again
- Gave Spark a phase skimmer ability
- Tempest drones can now roam
- Adjusted drones with light MGs to be slower like in Starfarer

Major shift back (redownload to acquire)
- Restored previous missile and fighter balancing
- Phase cloak now has a 2 second cooldown and uses 0-flux boost
- Removed Transparency and Hyperarmor
- Restored Delicate and Rugged

- Note phase  cloak no longer accelerates time

- Frigates still somewhat slow
- Hyperion now has a 10 second cooldown on the ship system

- Derelict costs increased from 3 and 6 to 4 and 8
- Remnant frigates DP cost increased by 1

- Vanguard, Tempest, Scarab now 8 DP

- Brawler uses mav jets again

- Both flare systems now gain back charges to an extent
- Have a 5 second cooldown

- Reduced Heatseeker's fuel quantity from 15 to 7.5 seconds (by 50%, might have gotten the number wrong here) (reverted)

- All versions of the displacer now have 3 charges again instead of 2

- Doom mines have twice as much health to compensate for the fact that phase cloak's time acceleration no longer boosts its system

Revert minor (redownload to acquire)
- Phase cloak again has 0 second cooldown
- Has 0-flux boost when travelling to compensate for some AI errors

- Restored Transparency and Hyperarmour

Reverting (redownload to acquire)
- Reverted frigate mobility nerfs

- Rebalanced DP costs of premium frigates back to somewhat sensible levels

- Nerfed stations by halving their hull and armour durability stats, including drones which go back to vanilla stats instead
- This was done to make orbital stations less overpowered and easier to kill with smaller ships

Mioidawndioaw (redownload to acquire)
- Increased Thumper damage from 90 to 150
- Increased Heavy Mortar's range to 700
- Increased base armour to 15%

- Reverted Hyperarmour and Transparency
- Delicate increases PPT decay by 25% not 50%

- Sunder mobility nerfed

Doot (redownload to acquire)
- Reverted Thumper to 90 damage
- Reverted 15% minimal residual armour
